title: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析
subcategoryTitle: 光子測試、漂移與設計驗證
subcategoryTitleEn: Photonic test, drift and design verification
summary: 從熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate coupled temperature fields, warpage, interfaces and optical modes, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 耦合模型與熱路
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「耦合模型與熱路」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine coupled models and heat paths, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 模型分區：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「模型分區」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for model partition, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「模型分區」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for model partition, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。
steps.observationEn: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Free expansion equals constrained-package stress. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交模型分區的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for model partition, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。
knowledge.textEn: Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。
knowledge.textEn: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Δu≈ΔαLΔT；光相位 Δφ=(2π/λ)Δ(neffL)，須區分材料與幾何項。 小變形、局部線性近似；不同晶向、塑性與黏彈歷史需另建模型。
knowledge.textEn: Δu≈ΔαLΔT; optical phase Δφ=(2π/λ)Δ(neffL) separates material and geometric terms. Small-deformation/local-linear approximation; crystal orientation, plasticity and viscoelastic history need separate models.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「光子封裝熱機耦合分析」的「模型分區：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Model partition: model and design” in “Thermomechanical analysis of photonic packages”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 要審查「模型分區」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing model partition?
options: 電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。
自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。
所有尖角最大應力都能直接當失效門檻。
optionsEn: Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales.
Every corner peak is a valid failure threshold.
quiz.explanation: 電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。 畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。
quiz.explanationEn: Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales. Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.

steps.title: 模型分區：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「模型分區」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。」與錯誤假說「所有尖角最大應力都能直接當失效門檻。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales." against the incorrect hypothesis "Every corner peak is a valid failure threshold."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。
steps.observationEn: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有尖角最大應力都能直接當失效門檻。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Every corner peak is a valid failure threshold. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交模型分區的量測判別表：畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for model partition: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「熱阻分解」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。界面接觸熱阻和材料體熱阻可產生相同總溫升，但改善方法不同。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較不同厚度與接觸壓力的溫升，建立能分離兩項的實驗。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設兩材料 CTE 差 Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K、長度 L=10 mm、溫差 ΔT=50 K，自由失配位移 Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm。這不是實際封裝位移或應力；機械拘束、翹曲與材料溫度依賴尚未加入。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for thermal-resistance decomposition, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Interface and bulk resistance can produce the same rise but need different remedies. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare thickness and contact-pressure sweeps to separate the two terms. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K, L=10 mm and ΔT=50 K. Free mismatch Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm. This is not actual package displacement or stress; constraints, curvature and temperature-dependent properties are omitted.
